searches.reason: Develop probes that distinguish recent-context use from broad similarity. Use paired training-history prefixes, fixed candidates, recent versus matched random deletions, and latest-item-preserving permutations. Seek identity controls, injected readout/MASK faults, and user-clustered uncertainty to validate sensitivity without claiming causal intent or changing the host evaluator.

searches.reason: Turn qualitative feedback into an evidence-grounded recommendation audit: concrete choice versus tentative interest, redundant capabilities, explicit specification conflicts, and recent-interest matches. Seek methods using only supplied histories, timestamps, titles, descriptions, and observed feedback, with abstention for unknown compatibility or needs. Calibrate against annotated examples and report uncertainty for the twenty-user sample rather than inferring latent traits.

searches.reason: Connect failures to training signals within the single BERT4Rec model. Investigate branch-gradient conflict and variance separately for embeddings and encoder, using actual loss denominators and coefficients. First reconcile fixed 64/64 snapshots with Bernoulli-allocation definitions through checkpoint-bound provenance and executable accounting checks; then test whether measured gradients explain appended-MASK ranking failures rather than treating allocation shares or geometry as performance evidence.
